newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Yields fall on 91-day Lithuanian t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on 91-day Lithuanian t-bills.

text.p: Yields fell on 91-day Lithuanian Treasury bills on Monday and all of the 50 million litas issue was sold as it was oversubscribed, the central bank said.
The average yield was 11.05 percent, down from the 11.25 percent offered to buyers at the last auction for 91-day paper on March 25.
The settlement date is April 10 and the bills mature on July 10.
